consequence.statement: Values set for bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR and bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP no longer take effect, so metallb-bgp based BGP announcements stop.
consequence.remediation: Remove these keys and configure BGP announcements via the bgpControlPlane options.

assertion.statement: The metallb-bgp Helm options bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR and bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP were removed in 1.17.0; BGP announcements must use the bgpControlPlane options.
